'''2008 Worlds Team Jan Westergard LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jan Westergard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
